results.question: Site Visit/ Site Location
results.answer:
• Site Location: CA-2, Manayata Residency, Manyata Tech Park, Thanisandra, Bengaluru (Google Coordinates: 13.053478559809621, 77.62014079662707).
• Site Visit Conditions: Tenderers are advised to visit the site and its surroundings prior to tendering to satisfy themselves regarding local conditions, working constraints, access roads, availability of water & power supply, taxes/duties, and weather/contingencies. Tenderers are deemed to have considered site conditions whether inspected or not, and no extra charges/claims shall be entertained.
• Site Handover: Site for construction may be made available in phases as per availability and progress of work. In case of delay in handing over the site, NBCC shall only consider suitable Extension of Time (EOT) and no price revision or compensation towards idleness of labor/equipment shall be entertained.

results.question: Minimum value of work to be executed interim RA payment
R.A Bill Payments
results.answer:
• Security Deposit / Retention Money: 5% of the gross value of each running/final bill shall be deducted.
• Mobilization Advance Interest: Simple Interest Rate @ 10% Per Annum applies on mobilization/other advances.
• Specialized Works Guarantee Withholding: 5% of the cost of specialized civil works shall be withheld and released after 5 years.
• Payment Basis: Bidders quote total cost in tender including all works as per specifications; individual items of work will not be measured and paid separately.
results.source: Document: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 18, Annexure-I Memorandum, Sl. No. 8 & 13; Document: 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 8 & 9

results.question: Price Escalation
results.answer: All rates as per Bill of Quantities (BOQ) quoted by contractor shall be firm and fixed for entire contract period as well as extended period for completion of the works. No escalation shall be applicable on this contract.
results.source: Document: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 19, Annexure-I Memorandum, Sl. No. 17 (CC / Clause 7.0)

results.question: Retension Money
results.answer: 5% (Five Percent Only) of the gross value of each running/final bill.
results.source: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 18, Annexure-I (Memorandum), Sl. No. 13 / Clause CC / 3.0

results.question: Release of Retension Money
results.answer:
• For specialized items for Civil works: 5% of the cost of the work shall be withheld which shall be released after 5 years.
• General retention money release timeline: Not specified in the provided text.
results.source: 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 9, Preamble

results.question: Security Deposite
results.answer: 5% (Five Percent Only) of the gross value of each running/final bill.
results.source: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 18, Annexure-I (Memorandum), Sl. No. 13 / Clause CC / 3.0

results.question: Release of Security Deposite
results.answer:
• Option 1: For specialized Civil works, 5% of the cost of the work shall be withheld and released after 5 years from the certified date of completion.
• Option 2: Security Deposit/Retention Money is deducted @ 5% of the gross value of each running/final bill; Bank Guarantee for waterproofing work and anti-termite treatment (CC/52.0) must be submitted before the release of security deposit.
results.source: Document: 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 9, Section: Technical Specification (Civil) Preamble & Document: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 18, Annexure-I Memorandum, Items 13 & 20

results.question: Performance Security
results.answer:
• Performance Guarantee: 5.00 % (Five Percent Only) of contract value within 15 days from the issue of Letter of Award.
• Additional Performance Guarantee (in case of Abnormally Low Bid where winning quote is less than 85% of estimated cost): Full amount equivalent to the difference between 85% of Estimated Cost put to tender and ALB.
results.source: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 18, Annexure-I (Memorandum), Sl. No. 11 & 12 / Clause CC / 2.0 & 2.6

results.question: Defect liability period
results.answer:
• General Defect Liability Period: 24 (Twenty-Four) months from the date of taking over of the works by NBCC or client, whichever is later.
• Specialized Civil Works Guarantee Period: 5 (Five) years from the certified date of completion of the work.

results.question: First Aid Facilities & Emergency Set-up
results.answer:
• First Aid Kit: 4 complete sets required as part of field laboratory setup.
• Health & Sanitary Provisions: Contractor shall comply with Model Rules for the Protection of Health and Sanitary Arrangements for Workers as per Section 4 of GCC.
results.source: 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 15, Section 5(xiii)(e); GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 7, Section 4

results.question: Material & Samples
results.answer:
• Prior Approval: If specification for a material/product is not provided, the contractor shall submit specification and obtain prior approval from NBCC/Consultant before use.
• Mock-up & Samples: Contractor shall prepare shop drawings and execute mock-ups for specialized/finishing items in specified colors/shades (minimum 3 options) for approval.
• General Clause: Governed by Clause 29.0 (Materials and Samples) of General Conditions of Contract.
results.source: 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 3, Section A & Page 11, Section 3(i); GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 5, Clause 29.0

results.question: Material Testing Laboratory
results.answer:
• Field Lab Setup: Contractor at his own cost shall set up a fully furnished and adequately equipped field laboratory at site within 60 days from scheduled date of start, including office space for engineers, sample storage, tables, wash basin, toilet facility, and minimum testing equipment.
• Equipment List: Includes liquid/plastic limit sets, moisture content set, compaction moulds, sand density apparatus, sieves, concrete slump cones, cube moulds (min 144), compression testing machine, temperature controlled curing tank, total station, auto level, etc.
• Penalty for Failure: Rs. 500.00 per day per equipment/apparatus debited to contractor's account for failure to set up laboratory, provide equipment, or replace broken equipment.
results.source: 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 13-16, Section 5

results.question: Barricading
results.answer: • Concertina Coil Fencing: Providing and fixing concertina coil fencing with punched tape concertina coil 600 mm dia 10 m openable length, having 50 rounds per 6 m length, up to 3 m height of wall with existing angle iron 'Y' shaped placed 2.4 m or 3.0 m apart and 9 horizontal R.B.T. reinforced barbed wire.
results.source: 19 BOQ_Combined__compressed.pdf, Page 12, Item 35

results.question: Use Of Low-Voc Paints/Adhesives/Sealants
results.answer:
• Interior Paint: Premium acrylic emulsion paint of interior grade having VOC content less than 50 grams/litre.
• Flooring Adhesive: VOC content of flooring adhesive should be < 65 g/l or No/zero-VOC (such as acrylics or phenolic resins, phenol formaldehydes).
• Primers & Topcoats: Fast drying low VOC epoxy zinc phosphate primer and Polyurethane topcoat confirming to LEED V4 for VOC emission.
• Waterproofing Systems: Seamless hybrid Polyurea Polyurethane membrane and crystalline waterproofing systems specified as 100% Solids, VOC Free / Zero VOC.
results.source: 19 BOQ_Combined__compressed.pdf, Page 10, Item 21 & Page 27, Item 158; 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 19, 29, 32, 33, 36

results.question: Site Signages
results.answer:
• Scope: Internal & External Signage system (illuminated & non-illuminated) included under scope of works.
• BOQ Provision: Total allocated cost for Signage Work is Rs. 76,90,630.00.
results.source: 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 3, Section A(k); 19 BOQ_Combined__compressed.pdf, Page 2, Section B(V)

results.question: Office for Client
results.answer:
• GCC Provision: Clause 70.0 mandates 'Furnished Office Accommodation & Mobility Communication to be Arranged by Contractor'.
• Field Lab Office Space: Contractor's field laboratory setup at site shall also include office space for engineers.
results.source: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 7, Clause 70.0; 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 13, Section 5

results.question: Trasportation for Client
results.answer:
• GCC Provision: Clause 70.0 mandates mobility communication and transportation arrangements to be made by contractor.
• Testing Transport: Contractor shall provide necessary transport arrangements to and fro to the approved testing agency or laboratory during the construction phase and defect liability period.
results.source: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 7, Clause 70.0; 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 11, Section 2

results.question: Plants & Machinery
results.answer:
• Concrete Batching Plant & Transit Mixers: Batching plant for all concrete shall be used or ready-mix concrete from an approved source with transit mixers of adequate capacity (23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 10, Preamble).
• Field Laboratory Equipment: Fully furnished site lab to be set up within 60 days from scheduled start date, equipped with Casagrande liquid limit device, grooving tools, micro oven (35L, up to 200°C), compaction moulds and rammers, sand density cone apparatus, portable sieve shaker, slump cones, 150mm concrete cube moulds (min. 144 nos.), temperature-controlled concrete curing tank (60 cubes capacity), Schmidt test hammer, Compression Testing machine (electrical/hand operated), Flexural Strength Testing Machine, Total Station survey equipment (4 sets), Auto Level/Dumpy Level (4 sets), Bitumen extraction apparatus, Marshall stability testing machine, and Los Angeles Abrasion test apparatus (23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Pages 13–16, Section 5).
• Hot-Air Welding Equipment: Leister varimat V2 machine, Leister Twinny, or suitable single-seam hand welding equipment for HDPE waterproofing membrane (23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 18, Clause 1.1.A).
• Spray Application Equipment: Plural component airless spray equipment / high-pressure plural component pump (Graco EXP2 or similar reactor capable of 120-150 bar pressure and +70 to +80°C block/hose temperature) for Hybrid Polyurea Polyurethane Membrane (23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Pages 19 & 30, Clause 1.1.B & 1.1.G).
• General Requirement: Additional plants and machinery required to achieve scheduled progress shall be arranged by the agency at no extra cost (23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 16, Note 4).
results.source: 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Pages 10, 13–16, 18, 19, 30

results.question: Staff
results.answer:
• Accredited Representative(s): The contractor shall intimate the name(s) of accredited representative(s) responsible for taking instructions from the Engineer-in-Charge or authorized representative within 07 days of the date of issue of Letter of Award (GCC Construction Works 2026, Page 14, ITT Clause 12.0).
• Authorized Engineer: The contractor must have a fully qualified, duly authorized Engineer present for sampling, testing, and mock-ups (23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 11, Section 3.i).
• Field Laboratory Staff: Adequate technical and upkeep staff must be provided to maintain the field laboratory (23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Page 13, Section 5).
• Note: Detailed minimum technical staff deployment schedule/qualifications (referenced as GCC Clause 67.0 on page 82) is omitted from the provided document extract.
results.source: GCC Construction Works 2026 Contractor with 4 amendments_compressed.pdf, Page 14, ITT Clause 12.0; 23 Technical Specification_CB_Part_1_compressed.pdf, Pages 11, 13
